Name: Intravehicular Transfer
checklistText:
<size=21>INITIAL INTRAVEHICULAR TRANSFER TO LM/CSM</size>

1.	CM/LM are docked
2.	Equalize the pressure using LM tunnel hatch
3.	Open hatch using the Tools menu
4.	Press F4 to switch between the active spacecrafts.

Move the LMP and CDR into the craft:
CREW MEMBERS -> MANAGE CREW
